tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List session types and prices for booking therapy with ElloMind. Call before creating a booking so you use a valid session_type and plan_code.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Real open time slots (IST) for a session type over a date range. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: create_booking_draft
tools.description: Hold a specific slot and return a single-use pay link to hand the customer. Call check_availability first and use one of its times. Collect the customer's name, phone, and email first. The price is server-set; you cannot set an amount. Payment and consent stay with the customer.

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Retrieve a booking's status and Meet link to show the customer in chat. The booking already confirms automatically on payment (the customer is emailed the invite + link) — this tool does NOT lock in or create anything, it only reads the current state. Call it when the customer asks. REQUIRES the pol

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_booking_status · Public sink: create_booking_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_booking_status · Public sink: create_booking_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
